newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia govt stands by GDP growth forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia govt stands by GDP growth forecast.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday the government stood by its forecast of economic growth in 1996/97 (July-June) of 3.5 percent.
"The government stands by the growth forecast of three-and-a-half percent," Costello told parliament.

Retail trade data earlier on Tuesday showed a 1.0 percent fall in December retail trade and a 1.3 percent fall over the three months to end-December, which analysts said could contribute to a fall in gross domestic product in the December quarter.
The government forecast GDP growth of 3.5 percent for the year to June 30, 1997, in its August budget and reaffirmed that estimate in its mid-year economic review, released last week.
Australia has enjoyed a record run of 21 consecutive quarters of economic growth.
December quarter GDP data is due to be released on March 5.
